# Christchurch General Surgery

> Specialist Upper GI, general and bariatric surgeons and endoscopists at 146 Leinster Road, Merivale, Christchurch 8014, New Zealand. Phone 03 375 4949 (+64 3 375 4949). Email info@cgsurgery.co.nz. Healthlink EDI cwlssurg. Hours Monday to Thursday 8:00am to 5:00pm, Friday 8:00am to 1:00pm.

## Surgeons

- Dr Richard Flint, MBChB PhD FRACS: Upper GI and General Surgeon. Fellowship-trained at Brigham and Women's Hospital (Harvard) and Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center. Sarcoma surgery is a particular interest. Website: https://richardflintsurgery.co.nz
- Dr Steven Kelly, MBChB FRACS: Upper GI, General and Bariatric Surgeon. Subspecialty training at Addenbrooke's Cambridge, Edinburgh Royal Infirmary and Musgrove Park. More than 3,000 bariatric and 10,000 laparoscopic procedures. Website: https://doctorstevenkelly.com
- Dr Grant Coulter, MBChB FRACS: Consultant General Surgeon and Endoscopist, now in semi-retirement after 35 years of a highly respected career. Although he no longer performs surgery, he sees patients for consultations and performs gastroscopy and colonoscopy. Patients needing surgery are referred to Dr Kelly or Dr Flint.

## Services

- [Gallbladder surgery](https://christchurchgeneralsurgery.co.nz/gallbladder-surgery-christchurch/): laparoscopic cholecystectomy, bile duct stones treated in the same operation, usually one night in hospital, back to normal in about a week.
- [Hernia surgery](https://christchurchgeneralsurgery.co.nz/hernia-surgery-christchurch/): laparoscopic and open repair of inguinal, femoral, umbilical, incisional and recurrent hernias, and complex abdominal wall reconstruction including transversus abdominis release (TAR).
- [Anti-reflux surgery](https://christchurchgeneralsurgery.co.nz/anti-reflux-surgery-christchurch/): laparoscopic Nissen and Toupet fundoplication, hiatal hernia repair, gastric bypass for reflux with obesity, oesophageal function testing, Heller myotomy for achalasia. One to two nights in hospital, return to work in about two weeks.
- [Gastroscopy and colonoscopy](https://christchurchgeneralsurgery.co.nz/endoscopy-christchurch/): half-day procedures under surgeon-administered sedation for reflux, dysphagia, abdominal pain, rectal bleeding, iron deficiency anaemia and change in bowel habit.
- Upper GI cancer surgery (oesophagectomy and gastrectomy, Dr Kelly), sarcoma surgery (Dr Flint), laparoscopic splenectomy.
- Bariatric surgery (sleeve gastrectomy, gastric bypass, revision surgery) through Christchurch Weight Loss Surgery: https://cwls.co.nz

## Practical

- Direct referrals from patients are accepted; a GP referral is welcome but not required.
- Private surgery at St George's Hospital and Southern Cross Hospital, Christchurch. Both operating surgeons also work at Christchurch Hospital in the public system.
- Home page: https://christchurchgeneralsurgery.co.nz/
